name: Mrs. Moretti
source: The mother of Lira and Priscilla. She's raising her two girls on her own, as her husband died a number of years ago. She struggled quite a bit to make ends meet shortly after his death. However, she has gained some notoriety—some would say infamy—by becoming an illustrator for a popular "Gentleman's Magazine". By securing work with such a widely distributed publication, she's been able to afford her girls a very comfortable life, and give them both a chance to strike out on their own.
